facts.text: When GRAPH_JS is set it replaces the default graph.js path, which resolves under root as src/Dossier/www/graph.js.

HREF_OK accepts only an href of the form #/subject, #/fact or #/graph followed by an id of letters, digits, underscore, percent or hyphen.
The El innerHTML setter records a violation named innerHTML instead of storing markup.
setAttribute records an href attribute violation when the href fails the HREF_OK pattern.
setAttribute flags any attribute whose name starts with on, plus src, srcdoc and style.
